title: CPF_FINAL_TARGET_REQUIREMENTS §21 count is stale
actual_source: Canonical header and §22 define 169 canonical IDs, but §21 still says 162; 8 legacy aliases are explicitly separate.
risk: Completion denominator can omit 7 canonical requirements.
required_fix: Update §21 to 169 and add an automated canonical-count/legacy-alias gate.

title: Developer verification/evidence is not current-SHA runtime evidence
actual_source: 93 requirement rows, 56 finding rows and all 13 runtime commands/evidence are bound to cd5bacc..., while Final QA basis is 3aa1dd12....
risk: Old evidence can be falsely promoted to current release PASS.
required_fix: Re-run/bind all required evidence and runtime to current successor exact SHA; retain old SHA only as development provenance.

title: Approval FENCE_TOKEN does not protect terminal finalization from stale owners
actual_source: reserveReconcile increments FENCE_TOKEN, but finishExecution/markUnknown/integrity updates predicate only on request ID + RUNNING.
risk: Old owner can return after UNKNOWN→reconcile→new RUNNING and overwrite the new owner result.
required_fix: Carry reservation fence/lease/command token through invocation and require it in every terminal write; add stale-owner race/process-kill test.

title: Center-Cut reconcile treats non-terminal RUNNING/RETRYING as success
actual_source: reprocessCenterCutFailed returns SUCCEEDED when failedCount=0 and state is RUNNING or RETRYING.
risk: UNKNOWN reconciliation can finalize before owner terminal state and mask later failure.
required_fix: Only terminal owner states may resolve UNKNOWN; add RUNNING/RETRYING negative test and no-duplicate-side-effect proof.

title: Untrusted HTTP client can inject a valid internal transactionId
actual_source: TransactionContextFilter passes inbound transaction header to generateOrUse(); generator accepts any syntactically valid value.
risk: External clients can spoof/collide internal correlation identity and contaminate audit/timeline.
required_fix: Regenerate at external trust boundary; preserve only authenticated/trusted internal hops; add spoof/replay tests.

title: cpf-core imports mapper implementation physically owned by persistence-mybatis Starter
actual_source: TransactionLogService/segment persistence import com.cpf.core.mapper.common.logging.*, while mapper sources live under cpf-starters/data/persistence-mybatis and cpf-core has no downstream Starter dependency.
risk: Violates topology-independent core ownership and risks clean compile/publication failure.
required_fix: Move JDBC/MyBatis implementation downstream behind Core API/SPI or relocate owner contract cleanly; prove core-only compile/publication.

title: DB transaction summary persistence is not fail-closed for masking
actual_source: TransactionLogService directly inserts TransactionLogRecord; detail values are masked, but summary body/member/customer/error fields are not force-redacted at persistence boundary.
risk: Producer mistakes can persist PII/secrets in DB logs.
required_fix: Enforce masking/redaction immediately before DB insert and add malicious-record persistence tests.

title: V107 transaction lineage exists in vendor SQL but is absent from canonical platform-schema
actual_source: Oracle/PostgreSQL/MariaDB V107 create cpf_transaction_lineage, but current cpf-tools/db/canonical/platform-schema.json contains no cpf_transaction_lineage.
risk: Vendor SQL becomes an independent primary and Generator/canonical parity cannot be guaranteed.
required_fix: Add lineage to canonical schema/model and regenerate DB3/install/migration/rollback/runtime/generator artifacts from canonical source.

title: R6J DB3 verifier can pass while canonical schema is missing V107
actual_source: verify-r6j-transaction-db3.py checks vendor SQL files/columns/indexes but does not inspect canonical platform-schema or a real writer/consumer.
risk: Static DB3 PASS can hide canonical-source divergence.
required_fix: Add canonical schema/generator/writer checks plus live 3-vendor lifecycle.
reproduction: Gate source review + canonical mutation reasoning

title: cpf_transaction_lineage is queried as optional canonical store but no concrete writer path was found
actual_source: Facade queries cpf_transaction_lineage and federates existing stores; 07_05 adds V107 but no Java producer/adapter write path was found in reviewed change/repository search.
risk: New table may remain empty/dead and retention/archive jobs operate on unused data.
required_fix: Either implement authoritative lineage writers/exporters with idempotency, or remove table as primary and explicitly standardize federated-source ownership.

title: Retired BZA approval APIs return 410 in backend but checked-in OpenAPI still advertises active 200 operations
actual_source: Four legacy approval operationIds remain in BZA OpenAPI; BzaBackofficeController throws HttpStatus.GONE for all four. Routes correctly omit them.
risk: Generated clients/operation counts are inflated and contract consumers see wrong success semantics.
required_fix: Remove retired operations from active spec/client or represent canonical 410 retirement without counting as active consumer operations; enforce runtime zero-drift.

title: BZA checked-in OpenAPI omits standard security/error responses
actual_source: 84 operations exist; checked-in BZA spec has no 401/403/404/409/429/500/503 response entries, while final acceptance requires those where applicable.
risk: Generated client/frontend cannot be contract-bound to required failure UX.
required_fix: Export runtime OpenAPI with canonical error DTO/responses and regenerate client; test error matrix.

title: FileLog spool replay bypasses writer path safety, symlink defense, locks and file permissions
actual_source: Replay calls createDirectories + Files.writeString(target, CREATE, APPEND) directly using path stored in spool; it does not re-run CpfFileLogWriter safety/NOFOLLOW/lock/permission logic.
risk: Post-enqueue symlink/path swap or concurrent writer can redirect/interleave recovered logs.
required_fix: Replay through the same hardened writer primitive or revalidate root/symlink/locks/permissions atomically; add symlink/race tests.

title: Recovery dedup is disabled for target logs larger than 8 MiB
actual_source: Replay only scans marker when target size <= 8 MiB; larger targets always append the record.
risk: Restart/replay can duplicate audit/log events under normal production log sizes.
required_fix: Use durable dedup index/idempotency ledger or bounded tail/index strategy independent of whole-file size.

title: FileLog recovery test named dedup does not execute duplicate replay
actual_source: Test enqueues once and calls replay once; no second replay, >8MiB, symlink, partial write, disk-full/read-only or process-kill case.
risk: Current test can remain green while required recovery semantics are broken.
required_fix: Add adversarial recovery tests and mutation survivors for replay safety/dedup/corruption/process-kill.

title: Observability qualifier still accepts synthetic authoritative-looking records
actual_source: QA fake localhost server generated matching Probe+Metric+Log+Trace+Alert+Audit records and current 07_05 qualifier exited 0 PASS.
risk: A single compromised/mock endpoint can self-manufacture release evidence.
required_fix: Require independently authenticated store endpoints/provenance, mandatory sourceSha, immutable record identity and workload-side evidence generated outside queried stores.

title: Security negative qualifier accepts category labels without attack semantics
actual_source: 11 ordinary requests with category names xss/csrf/ssrf/idor/etc to an always-403 endpoint passed 11/11.
risk: Release can claim security negative coverage without exercising attacks.
required_fix: Category-specific corpus schemas, mandatory payload/assertion semantics and boundary-specific proof are required.

title: Resource qualifier does not compare observed resource usage to declared limits
actual_source: Fake probe returned memory limit=1 and observed=999999999 with booleans true; gate exited 0.
risk: Severe resource-budget breach can PASS release qualification.
required_fix: Independently compare numeric observations to limits and require measured workload/cleanup evidence.

title: Batch semantic probe can pass on four booleans only
actual_source: Fake endpoint returned launched/observed/restartSafe/reconciled=true and gate exited 0.
risk: No actual execution/restart/reconcile identity or no-duplicate evidence is required.
required_fix: Require execution IDs, state transitions, restart identity and independently queried DB/runtime evidence.

title: Broker semantic probe can pass on four booleans only
actual_source: Fake endpoint returned produced/consumed/reconnected/backpressureBounded=true and gate exited 0.
risk: No offsets/message IDs/reconnect/backpressure measurements are proven.
required_fix: Require produced message IDs/offsets, consumption evidence, reconnect fault and measured queue/backpressure evidence.

title: DR chaos qualifier accepts self-attested scenario booleans and RPO/RTO
actual_source: Fake endpoint returned required booleans + RPO/RTO=0 and current gate exited 0.
risk: No actual split-brain/power-loss/rollback fault or restored-data hash is proven.
required_fix: Drive faults from independent harness and verify data/artifact hashes plus observed recovery times outside target response.

title: DB3 lifecycle default Java runner class/path is not present as a real repository module
actual_source: run-db3-lifecycle.ps1 defaults to com.cpf.tools.db.CpfDbLifecycleRunner in final-dev/build/classes/java/main; repository code search found no class.
risk: Live DB3 gate can be structurally present but not runnable by default.
required_fix: Provide real canonical runner artifact/classpath and test default invocation before live DB3 acceptance.

title: ADM CSP permits external unpkg runtime script origin and unsafe-eval
actual_source: TransactionContextFilter sets script-src 'self' https://unpkg.com 'unsafe-eval'.
risk: Conflicts with no external runtime CDN/script rule and expands XSS execution surface.
required_fix: Remove unpkg/unsafe-eval unless strictly justified; use nonce/hash CSP and runtime header tests.

title: Mandatory Runtime Qualification remains 0/13 PASS at current exact SHA
actual_source: Developer matrix is 13/13 미검증 at cd5bacc; QA environment lacks Java25/Gradle9.1/pwsh/live DB3/authenticated browsers/distributed target, and several gate-integrity failures were independently reproduced.
risk: Final product completion cannot be declared.
required_fix: Rebind every runnable command to current successor SHA and execute all 13 axes with immutable evidence; source defects must be fixed first.

title: 13 non-executable PRODUCT_ADM/MERGE_EDU handler classes remain as dormant generic ADM implementations
actual_source: Registry correctly exposes only EDU-ADM-02/03/04/07, but all 17 handler source files remain; 13 are disabled only by registry/catalog metadata.
risk: Dormant duplicate product logic can drift, be accidentally re-registered, and violates dead/stale-code hygiene.
required_fix: With explicit deletion/migration approval, remove or convert dormant handlers to non-executable documentation/redirect artifacts; keep regression that only 4 extensions register.
reproduction: All 17 current handler files + registry reviewed
